warnings: No explicit search query parameter supported in the endpoint catalog. Search keyword filtering behavior is undefined, so test cases do not include query parameters for searching.
Behavior for entering an empty search keyword is not defined.

testCases.title: Retrieve all products - positive scenario
expectedResponseChecks: each item in response array conforms to ProductResponse schema
contractChecks: Response array elements must meet ProductResponse schema
testCases.notes: As search is not supported explicitly, this test retrieves full product catalog to allow product browsing.

testCases.title: Retrieve all products with XML Accept header - positive scenario
expectedResponseChecks: response is well-formed XML representing products
each product in XML conforms to ProductResponse schema
testCases.notes: API explicitly supports text/xml response format.

testCases.title: Retrieve all products with unknown search keyword - treated as no filtering
expectedResponseChecks: response length may be zero or more (no search filtering applied)
each item in response array conforms to ProductResponse schema
testCases.notes: Since no search query parameter exists, this simulates a negative keyword scenario by no filtering; API returns full catalog or empty array if none exist.

testCases.title: Contract validation - response structure and headers
expectedResponseChecks: response body must be valid JSON array
each array item must contain all required fields in ProductResponse schema
contractChecks: Response Content-Type header matches Accept header
Response schema matches ProductResponse model for each product
testCases.notes: Contract test verifies adherence to API schema and headers.

testCases.title: Boundary test - large volume of products retrieved
preconditions: Test environment should contain a large number of products (>1000)
expectedResponseChecks: response is an array containing many products
response time is acceptable (as per SLA)
each product conforms to ProductResponse schema
testCases.notes: Verifies endpoint stability and performance with large data volume.
